fix: a total of twelve thousand men
reason: εἰς μυρίους καὶ δισχιλίους = twelve thousand.
ἠλᾶτο κατὰ τῆς χώρας: he wandered through the country; not expelled.

fix: For since they clearly knew what they had done
reason: συνειδότες is causal: because conscious of their deeds they could not expect mercy.

fix: even though they failed utterly in everything
reason: πάντων is genitive with διήμαρτον (missed everything at once), not subject 'all'.

fix: but believed that those urging this were speaking because they privately placed their own interest and security above everything else
reason: αὐτοὺς … τιθεμένους … λέγειν is plural: the advocates (Stratius' group), not Philon alone.

fix: so that the enemy could not cross and attack the embankments
reason: προσμάχωνται τοῖς χώμασιν: attack the Roman moles, not fight from them.

fix: one who is only human must never say or do anything arrogant
reason: ἄνθρωπον ὄντα = being mortal; ὑπερήφανον is the forbidden act, not the man's quality.

fix: because, as far as it rested with him, not only she herself but also the children were being saved
reason: τὸ ἐκείνου μέρος = so far as it depended on the general; not 'from his fate'.

fix: without saying a word to her, he had deserted and privately secured his own safety from the general, and how he could
reason: Hasdrubal is subject of πορίζοιτο; negation goes with telling her nothing. Sense was inverted.

fix: he dared now to sit beside these men holding suppliant branches, men to whom he had [...] many times that the day would never come when the sun would see Hasdrubal alive
reason: θαλλούς = suppliant branches; παρὰ τούτοις; sun is subject of καθορᾶν; lacuna after πρὸς οὓς unmarked.
